opportunities.name: Trap Full Pierce
opportunities.objective: Compare rear-target Q with and without trap reveal.
opportunities.mechanic: Q loses damage after the front target unless the rear enemy is W revealed. W also gives stronger long-range Headshot. AD/crit support P/R documented scaling; Shojin tests more trap/Q access without treating Q as ordinary crit.
opportunities.requiredState: Trap a rear target behind a front unit before Q passes through.
opportunities.failure: Trap avoidance or movement loses full Q exception.
opportunities.test: Compare rear-target Q with and without trap reveal; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Headshot crit scaling does not make Q an ordinary critical attack.

opportunities.name: Net Magic Retreat
opportunities.objective: Separate net, Headshot and Spellblade damage during retreat.
opportunities.mechanic: E has 0.8 AP magic damage and grants Headshot access. Rocketbelt adds movement, Lich Bane a separate attack after E, and Cosmic follows the magic hit. P/Headshot remains physical, so the AP escape trade sacrifices Q/R AD output.
opportunities.requiredState: Land E and use Headshot access before retreating.
opportunities.failure: Net interception or low physical damage outweighs the E gain.
opportunities.test: Separate net, Headshot and Spellblade damage during retreat; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: E AP scaling does not convert Headshot to magic.

ruledOut.reason: Q lacks a crit multiplier; P/R crit rules are explicitly separate.

unknowns: Stat(8)/Stat(9) crit interpretation needs verification; no undocumented headshot reset chain is assumed.
StatFormula annotations remain symbolic; verify the affected stat basis before numerical comparison.

builds.name: Trap Full Pierce
builds.summary: Compare rear-target Q with and without trap reveal.
builds.goal: Compare rear-target Q with and without trap reveal.
builds.hypothesis: Q loses damage after the front target unless the rear enemy is W revealed. W also gives stronger long-range Headshot. AD/crit support P/R documented scaling; Shojin tests more trap/Q access without treating Q as ordinary crit.
testPlan: Required state: Trap a rear target behind a front unit before Q passes through.
Compare rear-target Q with and without trap reveal; repeat at equal gold, finite stacks, same ranks and defenses against a moving target.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Trap avoidance or movement loses full Q exception.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Headshot crit scaling does not make Q an ordinary critical attack.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Spear of Shojin, Infinity Edge, The Collector, Lord Dominik's Regards, Essence Reaver, Ionian Boots of Lucidity. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Every [5] Attacks, Caitlyn fires a Headshot. Attacks while in brush count as [(1 + 1)] for building towards a Headshot.

Headshots deal an additional [((characterLevelBreakpoints(start=0.6, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 7, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.20000000298023224, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 13, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": 0.20000000298023224, "__type": "Breakpoint"}]) + ((1) × Stat(8)) × (((1) × Stat(9) + -1)))) × AD] physical damage. They have double range against enemies affected by {{Spell_CaitlynEntrapment_Name}} and {{Spell_CaitlynYordleTrap_Name}}. Headshots against enemies hit by {{Spell_CaitlynYordleTrap_Name}} deal a further @spell.CaitlynW:HeadshotBonusDamage@ physical damage.

Caitlyn sets a trap that Roots the first champion that steps on it for [1.5] seconds and granting True Sight of them for 3 seconds. Traps last for [30 / 35 / 40 / 45 / 50] seconds, and [3 / 3 / 4 / 4 / 5] traps may be active at once. This Ability has [3 / 3 / 4 / 4 / 5] charges (@AmmoRechargeTime@ second refresh).

Targets rooted by this Ability take an additional [35 / 80 / 125 / 170 / 215 + (0.3) × AD[statFormula=2]] physical damage from Headshot.

Caitlyn takes a moment to channel and line up the perfect shot, then she fires, dealing [(300 / 475 / 650 + (1) × AD[statFormula=2]) × ((1 + ((0.3) × Stat(8)) × (((1) × Stat(9) + -1))))] physical damage, but other enemy champions can intercept it. This Ability grants True Sight of the target during the channel.

Damage scales with Caitlyn's Critical Strike chance and Critical Strike Damage.

Caitlyn revs her rifle to fire a piercing shot dealing [50 / 90 / 130 / 170 / 210 + (1.25 / 1.45 / 1.65 / 1.85 / 2.05) × AD] physical damage. After the bolt strikes the first target, it opens into a wider shot that deals [(50 / 90 / 130 / 170 / 210 + (1.25 / 1.45 / 1.65 / 1.85 / 2.05) × AD) × (0.6)] physical damage.

Enemies revealed by {{Spell_CaitlynYordleTrap_Name}} always take full damage.
